public.text: The suggested institutional locations include the Ministry of Health, digital-health agency, or whole-of-government authority, but do not discuss the trade-offs among them.
public.suggestedRevision: Provide selection criteria covering legal mandate, proximity to health policy, authority across ministries, procurement influence, technical capacity, independence, continuity, and coordination with foundational-DPI authorities.
